units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:3">Ib. II, 3</cite> <cite ref="G00723"><he>אֶזְרַע</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A02727"><he>אָפַךְ</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="G00679"><he>זָרוּעַ</he></cite>, f. <he>זְרוּעָה</he>; pl. <he>זְרוּעִים</he> &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ חטים</he> sown with wheat; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:4">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> top <he>כשם … בנותיהן זרועות וכ׳</he> as well as their vineyards are sown with mixed seeds, so are their daughters &c. (faithless wives).

senses.gloss: to be sown, to be stocked with seed.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end, a. e. <he>בשבילי נִזְרְעָה וכ׳</he> the field has been sown for my sake.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:2">Shebi. IV, 2</cite> <he>תִּזָרֵעַ</he> may be sown; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to emit semen (also used of women emitting a secretion at coition).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 60a">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>איש מַזְרִיעַ תחלה</he> when the male is the first to emit semen; <he>אשה מַזְרַעַת וכ׳</he> when the female is the first &c.; a. fr.
